_comment: Inputs to the deny wall. scripts/render-settings.py expands this into
settings.json (live) and settings-rehearsal.json (live + every GitHub write
verb). Hand-writing the expansion is how the wall once carried 40 rules and
missed every absolute-path spelling: /usr/bin/touch evaded a rule for touch.
The bound is honest: enumeration cannot be complete, so this stops a
cooperative agent reaching a destructive verb, not a hostile one.
